blocks.text: Mikha Lim of P-pop group BINI used her birthday wish to express opposition to the proposed Pax Silica project in the Philippines during the group’s concert in Taiwan. As seen in the videos posted by concertgoers on social media, Lim was surprised by her fellow members and the group’s staff with a birthday cake during BINI’s Signals World Tour finale in Taiwan on Sunday, Nov. 15.
